name: Kakizaki Kageie
source:
"What could be more interesting than trading lives?"

Kakizaki Kageie is a fierce general who changes his appearance when he holds a sword. He approaches you with his animal instincts and tries to mischievously uncover your secrets...

Temperament: A sadist who is always too languid to be bothered by others. 
Likes: Candy

[Information taken from the official character profile.]
